description: This file defines the SocialMessagingClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS End User Messaging Social service. It includes method stubs with annotations for both synchronous and asynchronous calls related to WhatsApp messaging functionalities.

classes.name: SocialMessagingClient
classes.description: A client class for accessing AWS Social Messaging service, extending AwsClient with specific methods for WhatsApp messaging features.

methods.name: associateWhatsAppBusinessAccount
methods.description: Associates a WhatsApp Business account with the AWS Social Messaging service.

methods.name: associateWhatsAppBusinessAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a WhatsApp Business account with the AWS Social Messaging service.

methods.name: disassociateWhatsAppBusinessAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates a WhatsApp Business account.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccount
methods.description: Retrieves information about a linked WhatsApp Business account.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves linked WhatsApp Business account information.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountPhoneNumber
methods.description: Gets the phone number linked to a WhatsApp Business account.

methods.name: getLinkedWhatsAppBusinessAccountPhoneNumberAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the linked phone number.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specific resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: putWhatsAppBusinessAccountEventDestinations
methods.description: Configures event destinations for a WhatsApp Business account.
